claims.text: The source defines DCGAN: strided-convolution discriminator / fractional-strided generator, no pooling/FC layers, batchnorm (not on G-output/D-input), ReLU+Tanh generator, LeakyReLU discriminator, Adam 0.0002; 100-dim uniform Z with conv-hierarchy arithmetic.
Reported numbers: CIFAR-10 82.8% classifier probe; SVHN-1000 22.48% error vs 28.87% supervised same-architecture; deduplicated LSUN (~275k dups removed).

limitations.text: Occasional filter-collapse with longer training; no log-likelihood; global-average-pooling stability/speed trade-off noted.
